newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SILVA AND BEARDSLEY MOVES CALLED OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SILVA AND BEARDSLEY MOVES CALLED OFF.

text.p: Brazilian international Celio Silva's move to English champions Manchester United has been called off after the defender was refused a work permit, club manager Alex Ferguson said on Thursday.

Ferguson said United, who had agreed a fee of some 3.5 million pounds ($5.9 million) with Brazil's Corinthians for the 29-year-old Silva, had abandoned the transfer because British officials would not give the player a permit.
Former England striker Peter Beardsley has also had to change his plans after his Newcastle club cancelled his transfer to premier league newcomers Bolton.
Newcastle officials said on Thursday that they had decided to keep the 36-year-old Beardsley after losing Alan Shearer to injury last weekend.
Shearer, the England captain, is expected to be out of action for several months with severely torn ankle ligaments.
Newcastle have also lost their other England striker Les Ferdinand, who completed a move to Tottenham Hotspur on Monday.
